review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Some might argue that school should reward students who have the best academic results, while others argue that students who show improvements is needed to reward by school. Personally, I strongly believe that both methods of rewarding offer unique advantages.

On the one hand, rewarding for students who have the best achievement is very important. Initially, students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges, this may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards and propel towards overall academic gains. Furthermore, we can see this kind of competition in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. As a result, students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, so they can achieve success in later life.

On the other hand, students who show improvements is needed to reward by school, this method is also essential. Firstly, only a few smart children can come first and receive the rewards, cause others to think that their effort is futile. Because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals, they prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened and lose the incentive to study. Secondly, emphasizing improvements encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves. This method irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. As a result, the constant desire to outdo themselves, even benefits themselves more than the competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that rewarding for students who have the best achievement and who have improvements, that both methods of rewarding offer unique benefits.
review.overall: Cô thấy em đã triển khai đủ hai hướng của đề và dùng đúng praises and privileges theo dàn ý. Em cần ưu tiên sửa câu dài: xác định chủ ngữ, động từ chính và cách nối kết quả để các ý của em rõ và thuyết phục hơn.

paragraphs: Some people think that schools should reward students who achieve the best academic results, whereas others argue that it is more important to reward students who make progress. Personally, I believe that both groups should be rewarded.

On the one hand, rewarding students who achieve the best academic results is undeniably justified. Since they have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage them and other students to study harder to win rewards, thereby propelling them towards overall academic gains. Furthermore, this kind of competition can be seen in almost every aspect of life, where only the best individuals are rewarded. When students become used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, they may be better prepared for success in later life.

On the other hand, it is equally important to reward students who make progress. If only a few smart students can come first and receive rewards, other students may think that their efforts are futile because they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals. As a result, they may feel overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. Moreover, recognizing improvements can encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help them understand that they need to improve themselves constantly, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. The desire to outdo themselves may even benefit them more than the determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that schools should reward both high-achieving students and students who make progress.

paragraphs: Nowadays, Some might argue that dangerous sports are prohibited by law, & While others think individuals are free to take part in. I am personally of the latter school of thought provided, that certain conditions are met.

Admittedly, one might argue dangerous sports should be prohibited by law. This is predicated on the assumption that even a minor error can bring death of a participant, for example, skydiving can make people die, because they don't have necessary skills to join this sport. However, I think this law is unrealistic: Firstly, dangerous sports often happened in remote locations such as: say, mountain cliffs, where have minimal surveillance and control. Secondly, A police officer can't follows every individual to ban they if they want to join some dangerous sports. As a result, a prohibition exist only on paper, so that they drive practice underground make harder to ensure basic safety standards

Personally, I strongly believe people are permitted to do any sport, as long as they understand risks and receive sufficient training. Initially, If people want to take part in some dangerous sports such as: deep-ocean diving, bungee jumping, they should join some reputable club, which have appropriate equipment and qualified supervision. Furthermore, If there are some new players, they should be accompanied by an expert, who taught what to do when accidents occur, so that you can recognise dangers and respond appropriately. Finally, proper training and necessary precautions can make some dangerous activities become safer participation and no activity entirely risk-free
In conclusion, I believe banning is neither practical and not effective. People should freedom to choose, permitted understand conditions of training, awareness, make it is a more realistic approach.

completion.comment: Ảnh nguồn cho thấy bài có đủ mở bài, hai thân bài và kết bài.

review.overall: Em hoàn thành bốn đoạn và đã chọn đúng lập trường: được tham gia nếu hiểu rủi ro và được huấn luyện. Body 1 có đủ nguy cơ chết người, địa điểm xa, việc cảnh sát khó theo từng người và hệ quả hoạt động bí mật; Body 2 có câu lạc bộ, thiết bị và chuyên gia. Tuy nhiên, nhiều câu then chốt ghép sai cấu trúc: 'where have minimal surveillance and control' thiếu chủ ngữ, 'can't follows ... ban they' sai động từ và tân ngữ, còn 'People should freedom to choose' thiếu động từ chính. Lập luận vì thế có ý nhưng chưa diễn đạt ổn định. Em cần viết lại toàn bài, tự chỉ ra chủ ngữ, động từ và quan hệ của từng biện pháp với sự an toàn trước khi nộp.

paragraphs: Nowadays, some argue that dangerous sports should be prohibited by law, while others think individuals should be free to take part in them. I am personally of the latter school of thought, provided that certain conditions are met.

Admittedly, one might argue that dangerous sports should be prohibited by law. This is predicated on the assumption that even a minor error can cause a participant's death. For example, skydivers without the necessary skills may make errors that can be fatal. However, I think this law is unrealistic. Firstly, dangerous sports often occur in remote locations, say, mountain cliffs, where surveillance and control are minimal. Secondly, a police officer cannot follow every individual to prevent participation. As a result, a prohibition may exist only on paper and drive the practice underground, making it harder to ensure basic safety standards.

Personally, I strongly believe people should be permitted to do any sport as long as they understand risks and receive sufficient training. Initially, people who want to take part in dangerous sports such as deep-ocean diving and bungee jumping should join a reputable club, which provides appropriate equipment and qualified supervision. Furthermore, new players should be accompanied by an expert and taught what to do when accidents occur, so that they can recognise dangers and respond appropriately. Finally, proper training and necessary precautions can make participation in dangerous activities safer. Nevertheless, no activity is entirely risk-free.

In conclusion, I believe banning dangerous sports is neither practical nor effective. People should have freedom to choose under conditions of training and risk awareness. This is a more realistic approach.

paragraphs: Nowadays, some might argue that children have freedom to learn through trial and error, while other people think that adults need to help them avoid mistakes. Personally, I strongly believe that freedom to make mistakes should be encouraged and provided that errors do not involve serious danger.

On the one hand, some opponents of a trial and error approach often emphasise. Initially, In daily life, there are some mistakes are avoidable such as: knives, fire, electricity..., this is unnecessary to get hurt to learn to be careful. Moreover, parents need to shield children from harm, because this is their responsibility. They forestall children's mistakes, so that they can fulfill this duty. Furthermore, They also have trend to pre-emptively help children, so that they can feel peace of mind, and they did their best to protect and raise the child.

However, those on the other side have their own valid reasoning. Initially, parents cannot be around all time their children to take care of them, children always want to know more about new things, so that make mistakes is inevitable. Furthermore, If children do some things wrong, they will receive invaluable lessons, this stand children in good stead in later stages of life. Finally, children are shielded from everything, they will grow up overdependent on others, this is undesirable trait.

Overall, it seems to me allow children to learn from mistakes is necessary, this is a way to prepare for their future. However, providing that parents intervene and give guidance on important matters. The most important thing is parents prevent children from errors that may derail their future.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết bài trên đủ ảnh đã xác minh.

review.overall: Em có đủ bốn đoạn và đã cố triển khai cả hai phe với ba nhánh mỗi thân bài. Lập trường cho trẻ học từ lỗi và ngoại lệ cha mẹ can thiệp cũng có mặt. Tuy nhiên, nhiều câu chưa khép kín: câu chủ đề Body 1 dừng sau emphasise, câu ví dụ nối ba ý bằng dấu phẩy, Body 2 lặp các mệnh đề độc lập sau dấu phẩy, kết bài có một mệnh đề provided that đứng riêng. Em cần giữ ý nhưng viết lại từng câu có chủ ngữ, động từ và quan hệ nhân quả rõ.

This is a way to prepare them for the future, providing that parents intervene and give guidance on important matters. task.text:
WRITING TASK 1
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
The graph below shows the three different kinds of emission sources (oil/coal/gas) of greenhouse gas in the UK.
Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
Write at least 150 words.

images.alt: Biểu đồ khí thải từ oil, coal và gas tại Anh, 1990–2010

paragraphs: The given graph illustrates the three different kinds of emission sources (oil, coal, gas) of greenhouse gas in the UK from 1990 to 2010.

Overall, before 2000, gas had the number of million tons in three fossil fuels is not notable, but, from 2000 to 2010, Gas always had the highest number of million tons in all three fossil fuels. Coal is not like Gas, before 2000, coal had the best number of million tons, but, from 2000 to 2010, Coal always had the lowest number of million tons in three carbon emissions. Oil is not special, oil from 1990 to 2010, always had the number of million tons between coal and gas.

Firstly, Gas people used about 225 million tons of gas in 1990. Then, this figure increased dramatically to about 275 million tons of gas in 1995. Finally, this figure always increased in 15 years later, and had the highest point it is about 325 million tons of gas in 2010.

On the other hand, Coal always went down in 20 years of study, from the highest point is about 315 million tons of coal in 1990, to about 175 million tons of coal in 2010. Overview, oil is went down in 20 years of study but after went down from 275 million of tons in 1990, up to 225 million of tons, this figure went up to about 265 million of tons and end in 215 million of tons.
review.overall: Em đã nhận ra gas tăng thành nhóm cao nhất và coal giảm thành nhóm thấp nhất; phần oil cũng cho thấy em nhìn thấy nhịp giảm rồi tăng lại. Tuy nhiên, bài nhiều lần chuyển từ khối lượng khí thải sang lượng gas/coal được sử dụng, nên đại lượng bị sai. Overview còn nói oil luôn nằm giữa hai nhóm, trong khi năm 1995 oil thấp nhất. Mở bài lặp gần nguyên cụm đề, còn các câu dài ở detail ghép nhiều vế sai khiến số liệu khó theo. Em hãy xác định đại lượng trước rồi viết từng câu hoàn chỉnh với năm và đơn vị rõ ràng.

criteria.label: Task Achievement
criteria.comment: Em nêu đúng hai đổi ngôi chính: gas dẫn đầu từ 2000 và coal thấp nhất từ 2000; oil có nhịp giảm–hồi phục–giảm. Nhưng overview khẳng định oil luôn nằm giữa hai nhóm dù năm 1995 nó thấp nhất, và chi tiết liên tục gọi số khí thải là tấn nhiên liệu được dùng, nên một đặc điểm quan trọng bị mô tả sai.

criteria.label: Coherence and Cohesion
criteria.comment: Bài có mở bài, overview rồi mô tả gas và coal/oil theo nhóm; các phần nhìn chung theo được. Liên kết trong từng câu còn cơ học, nhất là lặp but/from 2000 và dùng Overview để mở một chi tiết oil, nhưng hướng triển khai toàn bài vẫn rõ.

criteria.label: Lexical Resource
criteria.comment: Một số từ xu hướng như increased, went down, highest/lowest được dùng đúng chiều. Vốn từ còn lặp và thiếu chính xác ở 'number of million tons', 'best number', 'oil is not special' và 'Gas people used', khiến phải suy ý từ biểu đồ.

criteria.label: Grammatical Range and Accuracy
criteria.comment: Câu đơn và câu ghép đều có nhiều lỗi; overview chồng hai động từ 'had ... is', còn detail có 'from the highest point is' và 'had the highest point it is'. Mệnh đề phụ đúng còn hiếm, nhiều câu dài khiến quan hệ giữa các vế khó hiểu.

paragraphs.text: The bar chart shows how much greenhouse gas was emitted from gas, coal and oil in the UK between 1990 and 2010. The figures are given in millions of tons at five-year intervals.

Overall, emissions from gas rose throughout the period and became the highest of the three by 2000. Coal emissions fell steadily and were the lowest from 2000 onwards. Oil declined overall, although its figure recovered for a short time between 1995 and 2000; it was actually the lowest series in 1995.

In 1990, gas-related emissions were the lowest, at around 220 million tons. They rose to about 270 million tons in 1995 and then continued to increase, reaching approximately 320 million tons in 2010. Coal showed the opposite trend. It started at about 310 million tons in 1990, the highest of the three at that point, but had fallen to around 250 million tons by 2000 and about 190 million tons in 2010. The last value was the lowest displayed on the chart.

Oil emissions followed a less regular path. Their figure stood at roughly 270 million tons in 1990, fell to about 240 million in 1995 and recovered to around 260 million in 2000. It then decreased again, ending at just over 200 million tons in 2010. Thus, despite the middle-period increase, oil recorded a net decline over the two decades.

task.text:
WRITING TASK 2
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Some people say history is one of the most important school subjects. Other people think that, in today’s world, subjects like science and technology are more important than history. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your knowledge or experience.
Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: Nowadays, some might argue that history is one of the most important school subjects. Other people argue that science and technology are more important than history. Personally, I agree with the first school of thought.

Admittedly, science and technology is very important in life now. Initially, Internet, AI and robot is develop dramatically, so that, students in schools need to learn how to control a robot or AI, because if they don't know this knowledge in the future it is very hard for to they looking for a good career which demand people need a good skill to control robot. Furthermore, in right now, AI can help students to do their homework, if you have a question, or a lesson, which you don't understand, you ask AI such as Gemini or Chat GPT, they will give you a answer very fastly. Finally, students in schools study science and technology well, can show for their teachers the depth of thought and have a good performance in class or school.

However, I agree with idea that history is as important as science or technology. There are many reasons for I think that. Firstly, after a long day in school with many many subjects, which demand students need logic, history is a simple subject, which can tell to students many stories in the past, is the best way for students relax, but they also have more knowledge. Secondly, History can teach students about WW1 or WW2 and many terrible war in the past, so that they can know how to respect anythings they have right now. As a result, students can find their motivation for their life and love their country more.

Finally, I always believe that history is one the most important school subjects. More over, history is as important as science and technology. Because history can teach students about social life and have many big benefits, history is one of the best subjects in schools in the past, right now or in the future.
review.overall: Em đã dành đoạn riêng cho hai quan điểm và giữ ý kiến rằng lịch sử xứng đáng được coi trọng cùng khoa học, công nghệ. Cấu trúc Admittedly rồi However giúp người đọc nhận ra em đang thừa nhận lợi ích của nhóm môn kia trước khi trình bày lập trường. Tuy nhiên, ví dụ dùng công cụ trả lời bài tập chưa giải thích vì sao học khoa học và công nghệ quan trọng hơn; đoạn lịch sử cũng cần nói rõ việc học chiến tranh dẫn tới hiểu biết hoặc thái độ nào. Em hãy tập viết câu ngắn, đủ chủ ngữ và động từ, rồi nối các bước lý giải thay vì ghép nhiều ý bằng dấu phẩy.

criteria.label: Task Response
criteria.comment: Cả hai quan điểm được trình bày và lập trường coi lịch sử rất quan trọng vẫn rõ, dù em cũng xem khoa học/công nghệ có giá trị. Ý về kỹ năng công nghệ và bài học lịch sử có liên quan, nhưng ví dụ dùng công cụ làm bài tập, môn lịch sử giúp thư giãn và lòng biết ơn còn thiếu các bước giải thích để hỗ trợ kết luận.

criteria.label: Coherence and Cohesion
criteria.comment: Bốn đoạn và các bước Admittedly–However–Finally tạo hướng đi có thể theo dõi. Trong đoạn công nghệ, nhiều vế nối bằng dấu phẩy khiến ý nghề nghiệp, công cụ hỗ trợ học và kết quả ở lớp chưa được nối theo một chuỗi rõ ràng.

criteria.label: Lexical Resource
criteria.comment: Em có từ đúng chủ đề như career, technology, history, respect và motivation nhưng lặp nhiều từ chung như important, good, many. Fastly, anythings, a answer và một số cụm như depth of thought thiếu chính xác.

criteria.label: Grammatical Range and Accuracy
criteria.comment: Em thử nhiều mệnh đề nguyên nhân và điều kiện, song đa số câu dài có lỗi hòa hợp, dạng động từ hoặc dấu câu: science and technology is, is develop, for to they looking, students relax. Câu ngắn đúng chưa xuất hiện thường xuyên để giữ nghĩa các câu dài ổn định.

paragraphs.text: Some people regard history as a central part of school education, whereas others would give greater priority to science and technology in the modern world. I believe history deserves to remain one of the important subjects in schools, even though the scientific subjects also teach skills that students need. Both areas contribute to a complete education in different ways.

Admittedly, science and technology are valuable because many people now use digital systems at work and in daily life. Students who learn how such systems operate can do more than receive an answer from a device: they can test information, solve practical problems and decide whether a result is reliable. For example, a class project might ask students to collect data about energy use and compare possible ways to reduce it. This would develop their ability to work with evidence, a skill that could also help them in further study or in a technical career. These benefits explain why schools should give science and technology serious attention.

However, history can be just as valuable for a different reason. Accounts of earlier people and events can engage students while helping them understand how their society developed. Learning about the First and Second World Wars, for instance, may help them recognise the costs of conflict and value the peace they experience today. A history lesson can also invite students to consider why people made certain decisions and how those choices affected later generations. This is more useful than simply memorising dates: it gives young people a way to think about their country and their responsibilities within it.

In conclusion, I consider history one of the most important school subjects because it develops understanding of the past and of society. Science and technology deserve attention as well because they build practical skills. Schools should provide opportunities to study both, rather than assuming that one area alone can meet every educational need.
